content.title: Denver Hockey National Championship Celebration Set for Tuesday at 6:30 p.m. MT - University of Denver Athletics
content.text: Skip To Main Content Pause All Rotators Story Links Live Stream 2026-27 Season Tickets Parking Map A-Z Guide Championship Gear DENVER – The University of Denver Division of Athletics invites fans to Magness Arena for the 2026 Denver Hockey National Championship Celebration on Tuesday at 6:30 p.m. MT. The event is free to the community. DOORS: Doors to Magness Arena will open at 6 p.m. MT. Concessions will be open when doors open. PARKING: Parking will be free of charge in lots 311 (ADA only), Lot C and Lot 108. (ADA entrance will be in the lower north lobby at the Buchtel circle). CLEAR BAG POLICY: Denver's Clear Bag policy and security screening at entry will be in effect for Tuesday night's event. The first 1,500 fans on Tuesday will receive a commemorative championship poster. Fans will have the opportunity to take a picture with Denver's four trophies from 2025-26 and get autographs.
